messages.subject: setwd() through .htaccess
parts:
Hi lads,

I've encountered a very peculiar behaviour of RApache. I'm using
local .htaccess file for RApache config, and if I put, say:

REvalOnStartup("setwd('/srv/http/blah')")

and I have this simple R script:

cat(getwd())

when I run the R script located in the same folder as .htaccess I get
root (/) instead of predefined working directory. However, if I define
R script as:

setwd("/srv/http/blah")
cat(getwd())

I get desired response, i.e. /srv/http/blah

What's the catch? I guess I'm missing something obvious here... O_o

This ingenious title is attributable to my lack of grey matter! This

evaluated, but if I set it in local config file (.htaccess), it's not
evaluated? Why is that? Anyone?
